Person.name: Person
Person.description: Entity x is a legal person under BNS Sec 2(26)

GroupOfPersons.name: GroupOfPersons
GroupOfPersons.description: Entity g is a group of persons

MemberOfGroup.name: MemberOfGroup
MemberOfGroup.description: Person x is a member of group g

CausesDeath.name: CausesDeath
CausesDeath.description: Person x causes the death of person y

IntentionToCauseDeath.name: IntentionToCauseDeath
IntentionToCauseDeath.description: Person x acts with intention of causing death of y (Sec 101 cl a)

IntentionToCauseBodilyInjury.name: IntentionToCauseBodilyInjury
IntentionToCauseBodilyInjury.description: Person x acts with intention of causing bodily injury to y

KnowsInjuryLikelyToCauseDeath.name: KnowsInjuryLikelyToCauseDeath
KnowsInjuryLikelyToCauseDeath.description: Offender knows injury is likely to cause death of person harmed (Sec 101 cl b)

BodilyInjurySufficientInOrdinaryCourse.name: BodilyInjurySufficientInOrdinaryCourse
BodilyInjurySufficientInOrdinaryCourse.description: Injury intended to be inflicted is sufficient in ordinary course of nature to cause death (Sec 101 cl c)

ImminentlyDangerousAct.name: ImminentlyDangerousAct
ImminentlyDangerousAct.description: Person x commits an act that is so imminently dangerous that it must in all probability cause death (Sec 101 cl d)

KnowledgeOfProbabilityOfDeath.name: KnowledgeOfProbabilityOfDeath
KnowledgeOfProbabilityOfDeath.description: Person x knows act must in all probability cause death (Sec 101 cl d)

WithoutLawfulExcuse.name: WithoutLawfulExcuse
WithoutLawfulExcuse.description: Person x acts without any lawful excuse for incurring the risk of death (Sec 101 cl d)

GraveAndSuddenProvocation.name: GraveAndSuddenProvocation
GraveAndSuddenProvocation.description: Person y gives grave and sudden provocation to person x (Sec 101 Exc 1)

DeprivedOfSelfControl.name: DeprivedOfSelfControl
DeprivedOfSelfControl.description: Offender x is deprived of the power of self-control by provocation (Sec 101 Exc 1)

ProvocationVoluntarilySought.name: ProvocationVoluntarilySought
ProvocationVoluntarilySought.description: Provocation was sought or voluntarily provoked by offender as an excuse (Sec 101 Exc 1 Prov a)

ProvocationByLawfulPublicServant.name: ProvocationByLawfulPublicServant
ProvocationByLawfulPublicServant.description: Provocation was given in obedience to law or by a public servant in lawful exercise of power (Sec 101 Exc 1 Prov b)

ProvocationByLawfulPrivateDefence.name: ProvocationByLawfulPrivateDefence
ProvocationByLawfulPrivateDefence.description: Provocation was given by anything done in lawful exercise of right of private defence (Sec 101 Exc 1 Prov c)

ExceedsPrivateDefenceInGoodFaith.name: ExceedsPrivateDefenceInGoodFaith
ExceedsPrivateDefenceInGoodFaith.description: Offender x in good faith exercise of private defence exceeds lawful power (Sec 101 Exc 2)

WithoutPremeditation.name: WithoutPremeditation
WithoutPremeditation.description: Offender x acts without premeditation (Sec 101 Exc 2, 4)

WithoutIntentionOfMoreHarmThanNecessary.name: WithoutIntentionOfMoreHarmThanNecessary
WithoutIntentionOfMoreHarmThanNecessary.description: Offender x has no intention of doing more harm than is necessary for defence (Sec 101 Exc 2)

PublicServantAdvancingJustice.name: PublicServantAdvancingJustice
PublicServantAdvancingJustice.description: Public servant or person aiding public servant acting in good faith belief of lawful duty (Sec 101 Exc 3)

SuddenFightUponSuddenQuarrel.name: SuddenFightUponSuddenQuarrel
SuddenFightUponSuddenQuarrel.description: Offence committed in sudden fight in heat of passion upon sudden quarrel (Sec 101 Exc 4)

TookUndueAdvantageOrActedCruelly.name: TookUndueAdvantageOrActedCruelly
TookUndueAdvantageOrActedCruelly.description: Offender x took undue advantage or acted in a cruel or unusual manner (Sec 101 Exc 4)

VictimAboveAge18.name: VictimAboveAge18
VictimAboveAge18.description: Victim y is above eighteen years of age (Sec 101 Exc 5)

VictimConsentsToRiskOfDeath.name: VictimConsentsToRiskOfDeath
VictimConsentsToRiskOfDeath.description: Victim y suffers death or takes the risk of death with own consent (Sec 101 Exc 5)

PrimaFacieMurder.name: PrimaFacieMurder
PrimaFacieMurder.description: Actus reus and mens rea of murder are prima facie satisfied

ExceptedFromMurder.name: ExceptedFromMurder
ExceptedFromMurder.description: A statutory exception to murder applies under Section 101

Murder.name: Murder
Murder.description: Person x is legally liable for the offence of murder of y under Section 101

CulpableHomicideNotAmountingToMurder.name: CulpableHomicideNotAmountingToMurder
CulpableHomicideNotAmountingToMurder.description: Act constitutes culpable homicide not amounting to murder

ActingInConcertOnDiscriminatoryGround.name: ActingInConcertOnDiscriminatoryGround
ActingInConcertOnDiscriminatoryGround.description: Group g of 5 or more commits murder of y on discriminatory ground (Sec 103 ss 2)

LiableToPunishment.name: LiableToPunishment
LiableToPunishment.description: Person x is liable to statutory penal sanction

Deceives.name: Deceives
Deceives.description: Person x deceives person y (Sec 318 ss 1)

DishonestlyConcealsFact.name: DishonestlyConcealsFact
DishonestlyConcealsFact.description: Person x dishonestly conceals fact f from person y (Sec 318 Expl)

FraudulentlyOrDishonestlyInducesDelivery.name: FraudulentlyOrDishonestlyInducesDelivery
FraudulentlyOrDishonestlyInducesDelivery.description: Person x fraudulently or dishonestly induces y to deliver property p (Sec 318 ss 1)

IntentionallyInducesHarmfulActOrOmission.name: IntentionallyInducesHarmfulActOrOmission
IntentionallyInducesHarmfulActOrOmission.description: Person x intentionally induces y to do/omit act causing harm in body, mind, reputation or property (Sec 318 ss 1)

Cheats.name: Cheats
Cheats.description: Person x commits the offence of cheating against person y under Section 318

BoundByLawOrContractToProtectInterest.name: BoundByLawOrContractToProtectInterest
BoundByLawOrContractToProtectInterest.description: Offender x was bound by law or contract to protect interest of person y (Sec 318 ss 3)

KnowsLikelyToCauseWrongfulLossToProtecte.name: KnowsLikelyToCauseWrongfulLossToProtectedPerson
KnowsLikelyToCauseWrongfulLossToProtecte.description: Offender knows act is likely to cause wrongful loss to protected person (Sec 318 ss 3)

BreachOfContract.name: BreachOfContract
BreachOfContract.description: Person x failed to perform a contractual promise owed to y (a civil wrong; relevant to Sec 318 Illus. g)

InducesDeliveryOfPropertyOrValuableSecur.name: InducesDeliveryOfPropertyOrValuableSecurity
InducesDeliveryOfPropertyOrValuableSecur.description: Offender dishonestly induces delivery of property or valuable security (Sec 318 ss 4)
